يمتحنوا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَحِنُوا (yamtaḥinū) /jam.ta.ħi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
# يُمْتَحَنُوا (yumtaḥanū) /jum.ta.ħa.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
